config.expression: if(({[default]Roastery/CurrentBatch/DropTime} != null && ({[default]Roastery/CurrentBatch/State} = 'Dropped' || {[default]Roastery/CurrentBatch/State} = 'Cooling' || {[default]Roastery/CurrentBatch/State} = 'Complete')), numberFormat(floor((now() - {[default]Roastery/CurrentBatch/DropTime}) / 60000), '00') + ':' + numberFormat(floor(((now() - {[default]Roastery/CurrentBatch/DropTime}) / 1000) % 60), '00'), if({[default]Roastery/CurrentBatch/State} = 'Roasting', numberFormat(floor((now() - {[default]Roastery/CurrentBatch/StartTime}) / 60000), '00') + ':' + numberFormat(floor(((now() - {[default]Roastery/CurrentBatch/StartTime}) / 1000) % 60), '00'), '00:00'))

onChange.script:
import roastery.core
	prev = previousValue.value if previousValue is not None else 0
	cur = currentValue.value if currentValue is not None else 0
	if cur and cur != prev:
		msg = system.tag.readBlocking(['[default]Roastery/CurrentBatch/AlarmMessageText'])[0].value
		if msg:
			roastery.core.show_toast(self, msg, 'warning')
